Name: load-table
Description: Name of the table file to load. Default when the option name is omitted.

Name: label
Description: Specifies the label used for identifying the table when unloading. The label defaults to the name of the table passed.

Name: top-down
Description: Indicates that the table is to be read top down. If no direction is explicitly specified all directions will be read by default.

Name: left-to-right
Description: Indicates that the table is to be read from left to right. If no direction is explicitly specified all directions will be read by default.

Name: row-header-index
Description: Specifies the one based index of the column containing the row names. If zero is passed the one based index of the row is used as row name.

Name: column-header-index
Description: Specifies the one based index of the row containing the column names. If zero is passed the one based index of the column is used as column name.

Name: pad-rows
Description: Automatically fills missing row items at the end of a row with an empty string.

Name: unload-table
Description: Unload table file identified by its label. This option accepts multiple parameters for unloading more than one table. Tables having the same label are unloaded in the reverse order they are loaded.

Name: template-source-file
Description: Specifies the file containing the template.

Name: output-file
Description: Specifies the file to output to.

Name: parameter
Description: Optional parameters used by the template forming an additional table. This option accepts multiple parameters. Therefore it must be provided last.

Name: use-intermediate-output-file
Description: Indicates that the output shall be written to an intermediate file first. This file replaces the primary output file when the generation succeeded and the intermediate and the primary output files are different otherwise it is being removed.

Name: intermediate-file-extension
Description: The name of the intermediate is produced by adding the given extension to the name of the output file. The extension defaults to '.intermediate' when omitted.

Name: markup-prefix
Description: Sets the initial tag markup prefix.

Name: markup-postfix
Description: Sets the initial tag markup postfix.

Name: markup
Description: Sets the initial tag markup prefix and postfix. This switch overrides the switches markup-prefix and markup-postfix.

Name: append-to-file
Description: The output is appended to the target file. This option is ignored when used together with the use-intermediate-output-file option.

Name: inlined
Description: Indicates that a file with inline templates is processed. An intermediate file is automatically used when processing files with inline templates if no output file is provided.

Name: inline-prefix
Description: A prefix that marks a line of an inline template file as template content. This string cannot be empty.

Name: inline-postfix
Description: A postfix that marks a line of an inline template file as template content. This string can be empty.

Name: inline-generated-postfix
Description: A postfix that marks a line of an inline template file as generated content. This string cannot be empty.

Name: inline-pad
Description: The number of characters a generated line is padded up to with spaces before the generated postfix is appended.

Name: reset
Description: Reset the generator to defaults.

Name: add-include-directory
Description: Adds an include directory. This option accepts multiple parameters.

Name: csv-delimiter
Description: Specifies the delimiter for the next CSV-files to load. Use 'tab' for tab separated items.

Name: csv-comment-chars
Description: Specifies a list of characters as string that mark commented lines in CSV-files when found at the beginning of a line.
